title: Arduino Uno + LED Circuit — Level 2 (Independent)
description: Independent challenge: Construct the LED circuit and select the appropriate digital output pin (D7) to drive the load.

steps.title: Place Current-Limiting Resistor
steps.instruction: Insert the 1k ohm resistor into rows E10 and E14 to limit LED current.

hints.missing: Place the 1k ohm resistor on the board between holes E10 and E14.
hints.wrong_position: Check holes: resistor must bridge E10 to E14.

steps.title: Place the Polarized LED
steps.instruction: Insert the LED in series: Anode (longer leg) in E14, Cathode (shorter leg) in E18.

hints.missing: Insert the LED into holes E14 and E18.
hints.wrong_position: Check LED holes: long leg (anode) in E14, short leg (cathode) in E18.
hints.reversed: Reverse the LED: anode must connect to the resistor node at E14.

steps.title: Power Bus: Connect 5V Rail
steps.instruction: Wire Arduino 5V pin to the (+) power rail.

hints.missing: Connect a wire from Arduino 5V pin to the (+) power rail.
hints.wrong_position: Ensure the 5V jumper connects to the (+) power rail.

steps.title: Ground Bus: Connect Ground Rail
steps.instruction: Wire Arduino GND pin to the (-) ground rail.

hints.missing: Connect a wire from Arduino GND pin to the (-) ground rail.
hints.wrong_position: Ensure the ground jumper connects to the (-) ground rail.

steps.title: Signal Pin Challenge
steps.instruction: Connect a signal jumper from digital pin D7 to resistor input row E10.

hints.missing: Connect signal wire to digital pin D7 and resistor node E10.
hints.wrong_position: The firmware drives digital pin D7. Connect D7 to row E10.

steps.title: Complete Ground Return
steps.instruction: Complete the return path: connect row E18 (LED cathode) to (-) ground rail.

hints.missing: Connect a jumper wire from row E18 to the (-) ground rail.
hints.wrong_position: Ensure row E18 connects directly to the (-) ground rail.
